patches.note: a11y verifier (layout chooser cannot be passed by keyboard on legacy, R0 and R1a): the "Choose Your Experience" screen is a named modal dialog that takes focus on load and keeps Tab/Shift+Tab inside. It is the legacy chooser that group C replaces with the layout auto-detect from R1b, so from R1b on the chooser is never shown and these three rows are inert there. R0 is mechanism-only and does not contain them (its chooser stays keyboard-inoperable for the week it ships alone). Extension part of group A (filed by the 2026-10-01 integration from the a11y fixer's verified proposal; tests/t0/a11y.spec.mjs T0-A11Y-28).
the Desktop card is role=button, tabIndex 0, Enter/Space choose it (same handler as the click).
the Mobile card is role=button, tabIndex 0, Enter/Space choose it (same handler as the click).
